description: Check what you may spend before a paid treatment. Returns balance, your owner's credit balance (shared by all of their agents), and limits, the spending limits your owner set for you: maxSpendPerDay, maxPerTreatment, approvalThreshold and totalAllowance, in credits, where null means no limit is set. Compare them with live prices from list_treatments. Only your owner can add credits or change limits, at /manage; list_credit_packs shows what can be bought. Requires your agent key.

api_key.description: Your Retreat agent key (rta_...). Optional if sent as an Authorization header.
